plan.title: eRFX RFQ Terms and Conditions Acceptance

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow requested by the case.
Open the buyer's Events list before creating the eRFX project.
Confirm the Events list rendered and the Create Event control is available.
Provide the mandatory event title so the project can be published.
Create the requested Technical plus RFQ stage combination.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the RFQ line item that the vendor will quote.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor, corresponding to Vendor A in the case.
Publish the configured eRFX event.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the Technical stage first to check that the RFQ-only clauses are not shown there.
Verify the required RFQ clause is absent from the Technical stage.
Verify the optional RFQ clause is also absent from the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the clauses should apply.
Confirm the required clause is shown to the vendor on the RFQ stage.
Confirm the optional clause is shown to the vendor on the RFQ stage.
Have the vendor accept the required RFQ clause.
Have the vendor accept the second RFQ clause.
Submit the vendor's quote after both clauses are accepted.
Assert that the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
